hero.eyebrow: Aadam · Forward deployed engineer · Accra GMT+0, overlaps EU + US East
hero.sub: I embed with operators, analysts and coaches, build the system they run their day on, and stay until the numbers move. Every toy on this kit is a system that shipped.
hero.hint: Tap stock, then Charge. Scroll to turn the dial.

c01.title: The counter
c01.note: A builder's merchant sold over a counter, with prices in WhatsApp threads and stock that never matched the till. I shipped a touch POS, a cashier queue that calls each order out loud, and one stock truth behind the storefront.
c01.hint: Ring up a sale. Unmute the cashier voice.

c02.title: Every garment
c02.note: An-Nur's laundry counter ran on paper slips and memory. Now each drop-off gets a code, moves through workstation stages, texts the customer when it is ready and closes with a scan.
c02.hint: Drag garments into the drum, then start the cycle.

c03.title: Commerce that
c03.note: Fashion brands selling African print to two markets. Prices are set per market instead of FX-converted, and the bag becomes a WhatsApp order, because that is where these customers already buy.
c03.m1: Markets, each priced on its own
c03.hint: Pick a silhouette and a print. Switch the market.

c04.title: Models that
c04.note: Before writing software for finance teams I screened 50+ SMEs for investment. The models I ship carry that habit: show the downside first, then the base case, then what breaks the covenant.
c04.hint: Hit the shocks. Watch the covenant light.

c05.title: Sell a dish,
c05.note: Delish ran on a fragmented POS and spreadsheets that never reconciled. On Odoo 19 every dish explodes into its recipe, supplier packs convert to pieces, and counts reconcile with a formula an auditor can follow.
c05.hint: Sell a plate. Then run a physical count.

c06.title: Shots and donors,
c06.note: I co-led turning an inactive court in Madina into a solar-powered hub, then built the platform that runs it: bookings, events, highlights and a transparency ledger for every cedi raised.
c06.hint: Click the court to shoot. Then open Court ops.

c07.title: Platforms people
c07.note: Exam pathways for West African students in three languages, verified rentals, an online pharmacy, an export platform serving 40+ countries. Different users, the same habit: ship, measure, stay.
c07.hint: Pick a programme to see the subjects it needs.

buildDesk.title: Hire me, or
buildDesk.note: Flip the switch on the device. Build sizes a project in weeks, with no price tags. Hire sets up a role and checks our working-hours overlap. Both print a ticket with what you did on the kit and send it straight to me.
